hero.name: KHALED
hero.intro: I'm Khaled, a full-stack developer (Vue, Node.js) and mechatronics technician at Schneider Electric. I turn real problems into simple, fast software.
hero.launch: Open RisPulse, my AI research assistant for court decisions (opens in a new tab)

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: From repairing phones to building AI-powered web apps
about.story1Text: I started out repairing phones and computers in my own shop, then trained as a mechatronics technician in Austria. Today I work in automation at Schneider Electric in Vienna.
about.story2Text: I wanted to build things people use every day, so I started full-stack training at Codersbay Vienna: Vue, Node.js, APIs and databases.
about.story3Text: I build web apps with AI inside, like RisPulse, a research assistant for Austrian court decisions. Knowing hardware helps me understand how real systems behave.
